[00:00:19.428] Beta function is a definite integral whose integrant depends on two variables. It is also known as Euler's integral of first time. Now let us define beta function.
[00:00:33.796] Beta function is defined as beta of m comma n is equal to integral 0 to 1 x power m minus 1 into 1 minus x power n minus 1 is, where m and n both are positive.
[00:00:51.108] Let me call this as equation number one. We can also have an alternate form for beta function. We can get it by putting x is equal to sine square theta in equation number 1.
[00:01:06.468] When x is equal to sine square theta, dx is equal to two sine theta cos theta d theta.
[00:01:15.076] Also, the limits of integration change with the substitution. When x is equal to 0, that implies sine square theta is equal to 0, that implies theta is equal to 0.
[00:01:29.060] When x is equal to 1, that means sine square theta is equal to 1, or theta is equal to pi by 2. With this, we will get beta of m comma n as integral 0 to pi by 2, sin square theta all power m minus 1.
[00:01:46.416] One minus sine square theta whole power n minus one into two sine theta cos theta b theta.
[00:01:54.244] 2 is a constant we can keep outside the integral sign. So it is 2 times integral 0 to pi by 2. Sin square theta wall power m minus 1 is sin power 2 m minus 2 theta.
[00:02:07.108] One minus sin square theta we know it is cos square theta. So cos square power n minus one is cos power two n minus two theta into sin theta cos theta d theta. Right? That is
[00:02:23.428] Beta of m comma n is now two times integral 0 to pi by 2 sin power 2 m minus 1 theta cos power 2n minus 1 theta d theta. This is another form of beta function, we can also call it as trigonometric form of beta function.
[00:02:41.988] Both the forms are important, so you can remember both the forms here. Both are useful when solving the problems. We can choose any one of these forms according to our convenience. Next, we will study the properties of beta function.
[00:03:01.796] First property is symmetry, which states beta of m comma n is equal to beta of L comma n.
[00:03:09.284] We can prove this by using the definition of beta function, which states beta of m, n is equal to integral 0 to 1 x power m minus 1 into 1 minus x power n minus 1 dx. Now let me put x is equal to 1 minus t in this.
[00:03:28.548] then dx becomes minus of dt. Also the limits of integration change with the substitution
[00:03:37.252] x equal to 1 minus t implies t is equal to 1 minus x. Therefore, when x is equal to 0, t is equal to 1. And when x is equal to 1, right, t is equal to 0.
[00:03:55.236] Therefore, now we can have beta of m comma n is equal to integral 1 to 0 1 minus t power m minus 1 t power n minus 1 minus t.
[00:04:07.844] So now you can take the negative sign outside and also we know minus of integral one to zero becomes integral zero to one. So beta of m comma n is now integral zero to one
[00:04:19.888] T power n minus 1 1 minus t to the power m minus 2 t, which is nothing but equal to beta of n comma m. Thus we have proved now beta of m comma n is exactly same as beta of n comma m.
[00:04:38.692] Now uh just now you have proved that beta of m comma n can also be written as two times integral zero to pi by two sine power two m minus one theta cos power two n minus one theta e theta.
[00:04:52.420] And now we know beta of m n is same as beta of n m, so we can also write beta of m, comma n is equal to 2 times integral 0 to pi by 2 cos power 2 m minus 1 theta into sine power 2n minus 1 theta d.

Transcript block 2 (source interval 000300-000599 seconds):
[00:05:13.060] Now second property states integral 0 to pi by 2 sin power p theta cos power q theta d theta is equal to 1 by 2 times beta of p plus 1 by 2 comma q plus 1 by 2 where p is greater than minus 1 and q is also greater than minus 1.
[00:05:32.676] To prove this, consider the diagnometric form of beta function that is beta of m, comma n is equal to 2 times integral 0 to pi by 2 sin power 2m minus 1 theta cos power 2n minus 1 theta d theta.
[00:05:50.596] Now let us have a substitution here. Take 2m minus 1 is equal to p and 2n minus 1 is equal to q. Then we get m is equal to p plus 1 by 2 and n is equal to q plus 1 divided by 2.

[00:06:19.780] So, m is greater than 0 implies now p plus 1 divided by 2 is greater than 0, that means p is greater than minus 1.

[00:07:00.452] Therefore, integral 0 to pi by 2 sine power p theta cos power q theta d theta is equal to 1 by 2 times beta of p plus 1 by 2, comma q plus 1 divided by 2.
